usage: Use 參觀 when you go to a place to look around, learn about it, or enjoy it as a visitor. It is very common for museums, exhibitions, schools, factories, and attractions.
It often sounds a bit more formal than just saying 去睇. For casual everyday visiting of friends or family, people usually use 探訪 or 去拜訪 instead.
A common pattern is 參觀 + place/object, such as museums, parks, historical sites, or an exhibition. You can also say 參觀 + place + 一下 to make it sound softer and more natural.
In spoken Cantonese, 參觀 is often used in travel, school trips, and organized activities. It fits well when the purpose is sightseeing, learning, or guided visiting.
